QuestInfo.name: Get a Job!
QuestInfo.0: You decide to ask #p1012003# about human behavior.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012003# suggested working to make a living. His first job is to go find his wife, #b#p1012106##k.

0.0: You want to fit in here? The first thing you need to, if you want to be a respectable young person, is to work hard! And get rid of all those... speed lines or whatever they are.\r\n#L0##bWhat kind of work should I do?#l\n#k
0.1: Youngsters these days are so focused on adventuring, they don't know anything about working hard! Moving logs! Pushing bricks around! Smelting things!\r\n#L0##bR-right.#l\n#k
0.2: #bMrs. Ming Ming#k's my old lady. She always has a good handle on what kind of work you can get in town. Go talk to her. I'm getting a headache looking at all your flim-flam-flashy lights.

yes.0: My wife should be in front of our house. Ask around for\r\n#b#p1012106##k.

no.0: I don't really care what you do, just get outta here!

1.0: Oh, hello there! I don't believe we've met.

yes.0: You were speaking to my grouchy old goat of a husband, weren't you?

npc.0: You still haven't found my wife? See? This is what's wrong with kids these days! She's in front of our house. Her name is #b#p1012106##k.
